proposals.value: LJMU will not be accepting applications from Pakistan for the academic year 2026/27.
proposals.evidence_snippet: Please note: The university will not be accepting applications from Pakistan for the academic year 2026/27.
proposals.notes: Official LJMU Pakistan entry-requirements page. Statement covers 2026/27; no statement found for 2027/28 (September 2027 intake). LJMU's visa page (https://www.ljmu.ac.uk/discover/student-support/international-student-support/study-visas) also says, undated: 'In addition to the visa brake countries listed above, LJMU has stopped accepting applications from Bangladesh, Ghana, Pakistan, Iran and Iraq.' Reviewer should confirm with LJMU before treating 2027/28 as ruled out.
